_comment: Tenant-assigned board categories. A record whose employer_domain is a key here is assigned that single category by TENANT, not by title text (normalize/enrich.py applies it after the title-based categorize()). This is robust to a source retitling its jobs, unlike a title pattern. The only categories that survive the shift as a SECOND tag are those in keep_categories (the genuine-Warehouse / genuine-Security exception), detected by the existing title-based category table. Owner-approved 2026-09-16: kroger.com (Fred Meyer + Quality Food Centers) -> Grocery. Owner-approved 2026-09-17: the eight pure-QSR/restaurant brands -> Food Services, so bare 'Team Member'/'Crew Member' titles categorize by tenant (all their jobs ARE food-service work). NOT applied to Aramark/ABM/Compass - those are mixed facility+food contractors that must stay title-matched. Owner-approved 2026-09-22: the NEOGOV/governmentjobs tenants -> Government (like Grocery: a public-sector board's diverse civil-service titles do not map to the retail/food/warehouse title table, so 77% fell UNCATEGORIZED; the tenant tag guarantees categorization AND scales to every state agency added). This also corrects 'Field Crew Member' mis-matching Food Services.
